# AgentWorkshop v0.3.0 - Table of Contents

Multi-agent orchestration from IEx. Backend-agnostic, MCP-enabled.

## Pages

- [AgentWorkshop](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [AgentWorkshop.Dashboard](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/AgentWorkshop.Dashboard.md): LiveView dashboard for real-time Workshop monitoring.
- [AgentWorkshop.MCP](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/AgentWorkshop.MCP.md): MCP server for Workshop. Exposes all Workshop functions as MCP tools.
- [AgentWorkshop.MCP.Server](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/AgentWorkshop.MCP.Server.md): MCP server exposing Workshop functions as tools.

- Core API
  - [AgentWorkshop](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/AgentWorkshop.md): Multi-agent orchestration for IEx. Backend-agnostic, MCP-enabled.
  - [AgentWorkshop.Backend](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/AgentWorkshop.Backend.md): Behaviour for LLM CLI backends.
  - [AgentWorkshop.Workshop](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/AgentWorkshop.Workshop.md): Multi-agent IEx API for coordinating LLM CLI sessions.

- Backends
  - [AgentWorkshop.Backends.Claude](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/AgentWorkshop.Backends.Claude.md): Claude Code CLI backend for AgentWorkshop.
  - [AgentWorkshop.Backends.Codex](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/AgentWorkshop.Backends.Codex.md): OpenAI Codex CLI backend for AgentWorkshop.

- Work Board
  - [AgentWorkshop.BoardWorker](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/AgentWorkshop.BoardWorker.md): A board-aware agent that polls for work, claims it, executes, and reports.
  - [AgentWorkshop.Work](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/AgentWorkshop.Work.md): Work board for agent coordination.
  - [AgentWorkshop.Workflow](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/AgentWorkshop.Workflow.md): Declarative workflows -- staged pipelines with file inputs.

- Agent Configuration
  - [AgentWorkshop.Budget](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/AgentWorkshop.Budget.md): Cost budget enforcement for Workshop agents.
  - [AgentWorkshop.Profiles](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/AgentWorkshop.Profiles.md): Reusable agent templates.
  - [AgentWorkshop.Skills](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/AgentWorkshop.Skills.md): Loads skill content and AGENTS.md for injection into agent system prompts.

- Observability
  - [AgentWorkshop.EventLog](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/AgentWorkshop.EventLog.md): Event history and live streaming for Workshop operations.
  - [AgentWorkshop.PubSub](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/AgentWorkshop.PubSub.md): Event bus for agent coordination.
  - [AgentWorkshop.Telemetry](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/AgentWorkshop.Telemetry.md): Telemetry events for Workshop operations.

- Infrastructure
  - [AgentWorkshop.GitContext](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/AgentWorkshop.GitContext.md): Git context injection for Workshop agents.
  - [AgentWorkshop.Persistence](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/AgentWorkshop.Persistence.md): Persist work board, store, and events to disk.
  - [AgentWorkshop.Scheduler](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/AgentWorkshop.Scheduler.md): Periodic task scheduler for Workshop agents.
  - [AgentWorkshop.Store](https://agent-workshop.hexdocs.pm/AgentWorkshop.Store.md): Shared key-value store for agent coordination.
